trace.final:
Task complete. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: Listed checkout-api deployments — the latest production deploy **v2.3.1** was unhealthy, while **v2.3.0** was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back**: First rollback attempt partially failed (us-east rolled back, but us-west and eu-west stayed on v2.3.1 due to an orchestrator error). A retry completed the rollback, putting **all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) on v2.3.0**.
3. **Verified**: checkout-api is now healthy across all regions, with error rate down from 0.18 to 0.002.
4. **Incident**: Opened a **SEV2 incident (INC-0002, on-call paged)** documenting the health-check failures from v2.3.1, the partial rollback failure and retry, and the note that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root cause is identified. (The first attempt timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to prevent a duplicate incident.)
